items.text: Summary of weekend #FantasyFootball reports: EXPECTED TO PLAY Puka Nacua, Zay Flowers, Ladd McConkey, Tyjae Spears; GTD/OPTIMISTIC Mike Evans; NOT EXPECTED Jalen Coker, Terry McLaurin, Keenan Allen; STARTING Tyson Bagent.
items.implication: Update lineups for expected actives; sit outs

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin, dealing with a hamstring injury, officially is inactive today in London vs. the Colts.
items.why: Hamstring injury suffered late in week; confirmed inactive
items.implication: Sit; look to other WAS pass catchers or streamers

items.text: Sources: Rams do not intend to limit Puka Nacua’s workload today vs. the Eagles.
items.why: Rams sources confirm full workload intended after hip return
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; full snaps expected
items.opportunity: Full route/target share vs depleted Eagles secondary

items.text: Baker Mayfield is dealing with a dislocated thumb that is expected to sideline the star quarterback anywhere from three to six weeks, depending on how quickly he is able to grip the football, per sources. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels will start.
items.implication: TB QB streamer needed; fade TB pass catchers somewhat

items.text: #Titans RB Tyjae Spears, dealing with an ankle injury and questionable, is expected to play today.
items.implication: Viable RB flex/handcuff play if active

items.text: #49ers WR Mike Evans was able to practice late this week despite a rib injury and said he’ll do his best to be out there. The team has expressed optimism, though as George Kittle noted, “Fractured ribs suck.”
items.implication: Monitor inactives; start if active but risk of limit

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker, listed as questionable for Sunday night’s game vs. the Lions due to a quad injury, is unlikely to play.
#Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is likely to play today after battling a foot injury all week, source said. McConkey recently fought through a rib injury, and this is not considered as serious.
items.why: Foot not as serious as prior rib; source confirms likely
items.implication: Startable but monitor for any soft limit; primary WR

items.text: #Ravens WR Zay Flowers, who was limited this week with a hamstring injury, is expected to play today, source said. He was questionable.
items.why: Source confirms expected; later reports no hard pitch count
items.implication: Start as WR1/2; elevated if full snaps

items.text: #Colts WR Keenan Allen (groin) has been downgraded to out against the #Commanders.
items.implication: Elevates other IND WRs like Downs/Pierce
items.opportunity: Higher target share for Downs et al

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua (hip) back. Speculation on snap limits, we'll see. Excellent spot for Nico Collins (hamstring) return: Cowboys inflate opposing WR by 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
items.why: Hip return + elite DvP/implied for Collins
items.implication: Start both confidently; Collins smash spot
items.opportunity: Nacua full routes; Collins high target share vs DAL
items.conflict: Earlier limit speculation on Nacua resolved positively by Schefter

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) LP-DNP-LP; already cracked rib. Eagles worse without Smith, Goedert, Baun vs Rams. Jordan Addison smash: home vs borderline secondary with JJ out.
items.why: Practice pattern caution McConkey; Eagles depleted; Addison opportunity
items.implication: Caution McConkey; fade Eagles pass; start Addison
items.opportunity: Addison elevated targets/routes; Wicks etc for PHI

items.text: Sunday injuries dump: IN Nacua, Collins, Swift, Irving, Pollard etc.; Q McConkey, Flowers, McLaurin, Evans, Coker, Spears etc.; OUT Williams, Daniels, Mayfield, Jefferson, Hall, Smith, Goedert, Price, Achane etc.
items.implication: Core status reference; beneficiaries for multiple OUTs
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups/handcuffs like for Hall, Achane, Smith/Goedert, Jefferson

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE: led all RBs 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches. CLE allows 88+ yards to RB every game. Full workhorse with Dowdle out.
items.why: 90% snaps, high touches, soft matchup, Dowdle out

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love @ NYG: RB5 utilization, 26 touches > W1+2 combined. NYG allow 5.1 YPC (3rd most); double-digit target share every game.
items.why: High touches/utilization, soft run D, receiving work

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO (35%+ TS w/ Penix, 104 ypg career); Garrett Wilson @ CHI (36% TS no Mitchell); Josh Downs vs WSH (31% TS, RZ); George Kittle vs DEN (climbing share, Evans day-to-day).
items.why: High target shares, soft matchups, teammate absences
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Wilson/London/Downs; Kittle if Evans limited

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA (low 3.5% TS, 25% routes, 42% snaps W3; SEA 2.9 YPC); Justin Herbert @ SEA (44% pressure, SEA elite vs pass, low implied).
items.why: Poor utilization + tough matchup for Hampton; pressure/low total Herbert

items.text: HATE Emeka Egbuka vs GB (rookie QB start, low RZ, low total); Xavier Worthy @ LV (shrinking TS as Rice rises, poor aDOT); Kyle Pitts @ NO (low 16% TS w/ Penix career).
items.why: QB change/low opportunity Egbuka; role shrink Worthy; historical low w/ Penix Pitts
